name: PIANO LEARNING V4.6 Formal Pedagogy
note: Custom 10→1 learning path based on standard piano pedagogy; not an official equivalence table for any single examination board.

domains.title: 技巧・音階・指法
domains.purpose: 姿勢、手型、指法、音階、琶音、和弦與觸鍵

domains.title: 五線譜・視奏
domains.purpose: 節奏、譜表、音域、隨機視奏與即時閱讀

domains.title: 聽力・聽奏
domains.purpose: 高低、旋律回奏、節奏、和聲與終止感

domains.title: 曲目・演奏
domains.purpose: 音樂表現、樂句、力度、踏板、風格與完整演奏

unlockRule: Each domain must reach at least 3 stars, and the grade total must also meet its threshold.
assistanceRule: Metronome is an assistance tool triggered after repeated timing instability; it does not replace independent pulse.

starMeaning.1: 尚未掌握，需要分解練習
starMeaning.2: 部分掌握，需要慢速重練
starMeaning.3: 達標，可進入下一階段但仍需複習
starMeaning.5: 非常穩定，可提高速度或難度
